scenes.en: Different power in each eye is common.
scenes.say: Is one of your eyes weaker than the other? It is more common than you think.

scenes.en: Each eye grows a little differently in length and shape.
scenes.say: Each eye grows a little differently in length and shape. So one eye can be more short-sighted, long-sighted, or have more astigmatism than the other.

scenes.en: You may not notice it. The stronger eye quietly does the work.
scenes.say: Did you know? Many people never notice it, because the stronger eye quietly does most of the work.

scenes.en: If one eye stays blurry, the brain may ignore it.
scenes.say: In children, this matters most. If one eye stays blurry, the brain may start ignoring it. That is called a lazy eye, and it is best treated early in childhood.

scenes.en: Cover one eye at a time and compare. Never borrow glasses.
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண்ணை மூடி சோதியுங்கள், பிறர் கண்ணாடி வேண்டாம்
scenes.say: Try this. Cover one eye at a time and compare. And never borrow someone else's glasses. Each lens must match each eye.

scenes.en: Sudden loss of vision in one eye: see an eye specialist the same day.
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண்ணில் திடீர் பார்வை இழப்பு: அன்றே மருத்துவர்
scenes.say: But if vision suddenly drops in one eye, see an eye specialist the same day.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for the whole family.
scenes.say: Each eye counts. Book an eye test for the whole family.
